- ⛔ The columns are owned by the storage service: they are read-only to the data door (`readonly` / system-owned on the object), and #26479 and #24548 keep trusting them.
- It is extracted from the 18.3.0 RC run, so it is listed in wave anchor #27377 §5 by the runner, and it is retested on the next wave.
